extracted.name: Baked Zucchini Casserole
extracted.description: This zucchini casserole recipe uses eggs and a generous amount of Parmesan cheese and mayonnaise to give this scrumptious side a quiche-like texture.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon salted butter, cut into small pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray.

Mix Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, onion, bell pepper, and eggs together in a large bowl. Add zucchini, salt, and pepper and mix until well combined. Transfer to the prepared baking dish and dot with butter.
Bake in the preheated oven until zucchini is fork-tender and top is golden brown, about 45 minutes.
